reasons.size: size or length of one message, field, file, name or text (bytes, characters, lines)
reasons.time: a time: timeout, wait, window, age, backoff or interval
reasons.page: page size or bound of one answer of a paged, windowed or summarised read; the caller reads on or the answer says it was cut (KOR-35, ADR-086)
reasons.answer: bound of the items inside one request, answer, record or audit detail, not of the things themselves: a larger set is split, paged or summarised by its producer, or the bound comes from the message size
reasons.integer: an integer, amount, identifier, protocol or format bound
reasons.retry: attempts and retries of one action
reasons.rate: rate, bandwidth or concurrency protection of one process, connection or session
reasons.setting: a default or the bounds of a setting (A5; ADR-075, ADR-088)
reasons.compat: the contract range of older peers, used only to answer them in their own format (ADR-088 section 1)
reasons.external: a bound of an external system or standard (GitHub, Linux, WebAuthn, Lima)
reasons.resource: resources of one session process: memory, CPU share, processes (05-runner.md section 4.3)
reasons.open: a count of things people or sessions create that is still a fixed value: to become a setting (KONZEPT A14; listed in the report of KOR-45)
